subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should PR #90610 be ported and landed as the narrow answer-candidate Activity slice, or folded into the broader native Codex progress work in #80039?
rationale: The code and proof support bounded answer-candidate visibility, but the permanent Control UI placement and relation to the broader Codex progress UX require maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Port and land the narrow slice
options.body: Rebase the PR onto the current ui/src/pages Activity structure, rerun the focused projector/UI/channel/i18n proof, and land it as the answer-candidate portion of #80039.

options.title: Fold into #80039
options.body: Pause this PR and incorporate answer candidates into a single broader native Codex progress/status design.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: Close or leave paused if maintainers decide answer-candidate lifecycle should not be a standalone Activity surface.

recommendation.title: Port and land the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR onto the current ui/src/pages Activity structure, rerun the focused projector/UI/channel/i18n proof, and land it as the answer-candidate portion of #80039.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server and Control UI progress work makes this the strongest available product-surface ownership signal.
